18 Da Nang hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on September 30, 2026 for Nov 4 to Nov 6, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Da Nang hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Da Nang hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Priceline at 6, Catchit.com at 2, klook at 2, Clicktrip.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, Mytour at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Da Nang rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 12 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Priceline at 6, Bluepillow.com at 4, klook at 2, Agoda at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, Stayforlong.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 6, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Da Nang hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 8% ($4 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 6% at Sandy Beach Non Nuoc Resort to 10% at DLG Hotel Danang. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
